The excursion begins with a transfer from your hotel to Pedra Bonita mountain in Tijuca Forest. From the launch site, there are sweeping views of Rio de Janeiro, its green slopes and the Atlantic Ocean.

Before the flight, an English-speaking instructor gives a safety briefing, explains the takeoff technique and helps prepare the equipment. After a few practice movements, you and the instructor run together from the launch platform and lift off.

The flight takes you over the hillsides and ocean and ends with a landing on Pepino Beach.

Video recording of the flight is included in the excursion. A DVD of the flight can be ordered separately.

The helicopter tour begins near Sugarloaf Mountain. After a short briefing, you take off above the coastline.

From the air, you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, the Botanical Garden, Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon, Corcovado with its Christ the Redeemer statue, yachts and bays. The route follows the coast and passes between rocky peaks. From above, the beaches, neighborhoods and green slopes come together like a map, while familiar places look completely different from the city's viewpoints.
